translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Kik isungri kuom kiny,
nikech ok ingʼeyo gima odiechiengʼ nyalo kelo.
We ngʼat moro ema opaki,
to ok dhogi iwuon; ngʼato machielo, to ok lewi iwuon.
Kidi pek to kuoyo bende pek,
to chandruok ma ngʼat mofuwo kelo pek moloyo gik moko ariyogo.
Mirima kwiny to gero pek moloyo,
to en ngʼa manyalo chomore gi nyiego?
Kwero ngʼato ratiro ber
moloyo hera mopandi.
Adhonde moa kuom osiep inyalo geno,
to jasigu medo mana nyoth mar masira.
Ngʼat moyiengʼ ok dwar mor kich,
to ngʼatno modenyo kata mana gima kech mitne.
Mana kaka winyo mabayo moa e ode
e kaka ngʼatno mabayo aa e dalane.
Moo mangʼwe ngʼar gi ubani kelo mor ne chuny,
to ber mar osiep ngʼato wuok kuom ngʼado rieko gi adiera.
Kik ijwangʼ osiepni kod osiep wuonu,
to kik idhi e od owadu ka chandruok omaki,
ber dhi ir jabuti machiegni moloyo owadu man mabor.
Bed mariek, wuoda kendo imi chunya mor
eka anyalo dwoko ngʼato moro amora machaya.
Ngʼat mariek neno masira kabiro kendo opondo,
to ngʼat mofuwo dhiyo adhiya nyime ma ohinyre.
Kaw law ngʼatno mochungʼne ngʼat mokia kaka singo;
kawe ka okete singo kar dhako mabayo.
Ka ngʼato ogwedho jabute e lela gokinyi mangʼich,
to ochalo mana gi ngʼama kwongʼe.
Dhako ma jakoko
chalo gi kodh ajiki,
kwerogo chalo gi gengʼo yamo
kata mako moo gi lwedo.
Kaka nyinyo piago nyinyo,
e kaka ngʼato piago nyawadgi.
Ngʼat mopidho ngʼowu biro chamo olembe,
to ngʼatno marito ruodhe ibiro miyo luor.
Kirango pi, to wangʼi iwuon ema ineno,
kendo kinono chunyi, to in iwuon ema inenori.
Tho kod kethruok ok rom ngangʼ,
to kata mana wenge dhano bende ok rom.
Dhahabu gi fedha itemo gi mach,
to dhano itemo gi pak moyudo.
Kata bed ni iyoko ngʼat mofuwo e pany,
iyoke kaka cham miswago,
ok inigol fupe oa kuome.
Bed ni ingʼeyo maber kaka jambi chalo;
bende rit maber kwethgi;
nimar mwandu ok sik mochwere,
to osimbo mar loch ok nobed ne tiengʼ ka tiengʼ.
Ka ongʼad lum oko eka manyien twi,
to ka ichoko ne jambi lum manie kor got,
eka iniyud yie rombe milosgo lewni,
kendo iningʼiew lowo gi pesa miyudo kuom diek.
Ibiro bedo gi chak mangʼeny mar diek
ma ibiro pidhorigo gi joodi kendo pidho nyiri matiyoni.
